intervention: Retain the union of every already accepted raw edge-pair interval on observed and ambiguous rows. One vote per distinct view, never an interval envelope or candidate count. Keep the existing three-view threshold, 1px horizontal allowance, nearest original row, no vertical dilation. Unknown, absent and missing rows still contribute zero.
paired_policy: Reuse immutable complete fresh fixture points, exact export cameras and saved finite patches. No new DA3, geometry fitting, point suppression, target identity, method-dependent selection, grid or downstream readout changes. Every base and candidate uses the same possible-support volume.
freeze_policy: This is development on already-scored objects, not a blind holdout. Freeze new source, analytic controls and all 18 rows before new inference and scoring. Retain old unique-row graphs for paired scoring; no post-score tuning or overwriting runs.
qualification: Photometric possible support, not unique correspondence or foreground certification. Candidate unions may retain clutter or painted lines; downstream PCA may still synthesize unsupported axes. Report all cases/scales, empty results and regressions. No general reader qualification, independent object claim or G1 pass.
